title: Decomplexation of Pb-EDTA by electron beam irradiation technology: efficiency and mechanism
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38815-38826
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA04993D, Paper
Open Access

Mengxin Tu, Lei Chen, Jianzhong Gu, Chengkai Mao, Yingfei Ren, Hongyong Wang, Gang Xu
By utilizing electron beam irradiation, one-step decomplexation and reduction of Pb-EDTA can be achieved. This research provides new guidance for the harmless treatment of heavy metal complexes.
